rules.statement: Every admitted public event carries source=CONFENGE_WEB. No other public source identity.
Missing Warmbly evidence stays UNKNOWN. Absence is never numeric zero and never a client-derived QCO.
page_view, engagement, completion and lead never become qualified_lead, qco, proposal, pipeline, won, lost or revenue.
QCO, proposal and revenue are readback from the downstream owner. Client-side is not a source of truth.
Documented aliases rewrite to one canonical name in the same layer. They are not a second count.
The same event_id is a replay, not a new observation.
A session keeps one nucleus_id or unknown. Switching nucleus is a new classification event, not a silent overwrite of the original landing nucleus.
public_works_b2g remains a first-class nucleus. Multi-vertical expansion does not drop B2G attribution.
CTR, screen time and praise are not willingness to pay and are not QCO.
Human protocol reactions to published price do not replace #341, which requires real proposals, deliveries and margin.
outbound_eligible=false and auto_send=false. Measurement does not authorize dispatch.
